senses.zh_definition: 条件性识别：若原文指人，Rene 可能是人名，也可能对应法语名字 René；现有资料不足以确定该词项的实际含义。
senses.en_definition: Provisionally, a personal name, potentially corresponding to René; the intended referent cannot be established without context.
senses.ms_definition: Secara tentatif, nama orang yang mungkin merujuk kepada René; maksud sebenar bentuk ini memerlukan konteks asal.
senses.nuances: 此处 noun 仅对应条件性的人名解释，并非已核实的马来语普通名词义。不能把 René 的名字词源直接当成 rene 的马来语释义。以下为姓名用法示例，非经语料统计确认的高频搭配。资料不足，因此不标为 official。

etymology.historical_story: If this token represents the French personal name René, its name history leads to Latin renatus, meaning born again. That history belongs to the name, however, and cannot establish what the lowercase corpus token means. Without its original sentence, neither a personal-name interpretation nor a particular pronunciation should be treated as settled. [Name reference](https://nominis.cef.fr/contenus/prenom/125/Ren%C3%A9.html)
